body:
#: 14
Decision: Big-needs pets' homes
Notes: Monkey: climbing tree. Seal: pond. Bear: cave den. Snake: warm glass tank. Each is a pet-yard item bought at the pet shop; the pond and den need pet yard level 2 or 3 to fit. The shop sells the pet only once you own its home

comments.text: 31 Oct: pond, cave den AND climbing tree need pet yard level 3 (rule 'Big-needs pets').

title: Pet decision 14: Big-needs pets' homes
